title: A Blind Viewer Checks Every Lesson Video First | vitalii.no
description:
Once lesson cards could render as short videos, nothing stood between an AI-written motion script and my kid's screen. A broken beat, an overlapping label or a nonsense animation would have gone straight to the TV on the wall with no one checking it first.

I added a render pipeline where a server picks up due cards on a timer and renders the final video automatically, with old files cleaned up after two weeks. Before any render ships, a reviewer and a separate 'blind viewer' step judge a contact sheet of the card's frames and can reject it. Only a passing video is ever allowed to reach the kiosk, and only through protected endpoints.

Every lesson video now passes through a reviewer and a blind-viewer check before it ever reaches a child, and the render itself runs unattended, checking for new work every fifteen minutes.
